singleton_scope.protected_decision: Whether the diagnostic-derived single-factor cash_conversion produces a research-only earnings-quality alpha clue (and a tradeable candidate) versus CSI300 in the reviewed PIT top-500 large-cap universe under one frozen primary cell.
applies_to: The future reviewed A-long large-cap cash_conversion signal-search execution package that may be executed only after independent review and explicit user execute.
does_not_authorize: No signal-search run is authorized by this ledger before independent review and an explicit user execute command.

No reinterpretation of the prior falsified large-cap pure-quality result, no old-result reslice, no relabeling the prior cash_conversion diagnostic as a pass, no factor-definition search, no multi-factor composite search, no production use, no ship-gate evidence, no full-size manual use, no provider expansion, no DataHub work, and no broker / order automation.
No new daily_basic pull or provider call is authorized; this design reuses the already-reviewed top-500 materialization, audit, and full-main-board fundamentals.

creation_reason.reason: The large-cap pure-quality composite was falsified, but cash_conversion was its strongest single-factor diagnostic (504d t=2.3542 vs CSI300, 4.5165 vs CSI1000), with an earnings-quality / low-accruals economic basis and persistence vs CSI1000 across two universes. Per the prior design's diagnostics policy, this diagnostic motivates a new pre-committed hypothesis tested on a new singleton ledger; it is not a rescue of the falsified composite and the vs-CSI300 evidence is single-sample.

budget_policy.spend_rule: The first reviewed A-long large-cap cash_conversion primary-cell signal-search execution spends one planned test regardless of falsified, statistical-alpha-clue, or tradeable-candidate result.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: If the future primary cell fails or is diagnostic-only, do not rerun with changed factor definition, universe N, market-cap field, neutralization, holding period, benchmark, top fraction, cost model, statistical threshold, sub-period rule, or risk-gate threshold without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update.

planned_tests.design_summary: Single primary cell: reviewed PIT top-500 main-board circ_mv universe, single-factor cash_conversion (OCF / |net income|, same period, |net income| >= 1e7, unchanged definition), industry-and-size-neutral marginal-double view, 504d, CSI300 primary; two-tier verdict (statistical alpha clue by HAC t>=2 / cohorts>=48 / both sub-period halves mean>0 / concentration; tradeable candidate additionally by relative-NAV drawdown vs CSI300 >= -15%).
review_boundary: This planned test is a diagnostic-derived new hypothesis, not a rerun, rescue, or reinterpretation of the falsified large-cap pure-quality composite.
The preregistration and ledger authorize no new data fetch, no signal search, no provider call, no DataHub work, no production use, no ship-gate evidence, and no full-size manual use.

cash_conversion was selected because it was the strongest in-sample diagnostic; even a passing result is an in-sample research clue, with single-sample vs-CSI300 evidence, requiring forward-live validation.
Diagnostics such as CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, single diagnostic factors, and the absolute-NAV drawdown cannot define alpha or rescue a failed primary cell.

next_required_actions: Independent review (Codex) must validate the new preregistration, schema, ledger, tests, and docs.

After review PASS and commit, a separate signal-search runner slice may be implemented (reusing the vetted measurement chain plus the rolling relative-NAV drawdown gate); its execution needs its own review, commit, and a separate user execute and spends this singleton once.
If the future primary cell is falsified, record it as failed under the frozen single-primary-cell rules and do not rescue from diagnostics without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update.
